info.name: Get an oEmbed response for a belharratx.com URL

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of the resource for which to fetch oEmbed data.

params.name: maxwidth
params.description: The maximum width of the embed frame in pixels.

items.docs: The oEmbed 1.0 provider endpoint. Given a belharratx.com permalink it returns the standard oEmbed rich payload — version, provider_name, provider_url, author_name, author_url, title, type, width, height and the iframe `html`.
